name: Finish and retain a first period tutorial
description: A reader completes the first-period walkthrough, returns to lessons, and sees progress after reload.
steps: Open the My period just started card on the home screen
Advance through every step by choosing Got it, next step and then Finish this lesson
Verify that My first period. Now what? shows Completed in Lessons
Reload the app and revisit Home
expected: The first-period lesson remains completed and the home progress shows at least one finished lesson.

name: Find a product and open its walkthrough
description: Product guidance shows relevant options, changing intervals, and a working route to a practical lesson.
steps: Open Products and choose Swimming or sports in the product guide
Open the Tampons product card
Check that the detail states change every 4–8 hours and never beyond 8 hours
Choose Show me the step-by-step
expected: The Tampons tutorial opens at step 1 with safety-first instructions, and the product selector shows an appropriate recommendation.

name: Use and reset the care routine
description: A reader can interact with the care checklist, reset it, and access the relevant FAQ and medical guidance.
steps: Open My care from bottom navigation
Select all five routine rows
Check that the routine completion message appears
Choose Reset checklist
Expand When is bleeding too heavy?
expected: Checklist resets to 0/5, FAQ answer is visible, and the When to get medical help guidance is present.

name: Bookmark and remove a lesson
description: A reader bookmarks a lesson, finds it under Saved, and removes it.
steps: Open Lessons and save How to use a pad using the bookmark button
Open Saved and verify How to use a pad is present
Reload the app and open Saved again
Use the bookmark button on the saved lesson to remove it
expected: The Saved page displays its empty state after the last bookmark is removed, with no saved lesson present.

name: Cancel and confirm clearing personal progress
description: A reader can reject clearing data, then confirm that completed lessons and bookmarks are erased.
setup: Finish the How to use a pad tutorial using all its steps and bookmark My first period. Now what? from Lessons
steps: Open Privacy & sources and choose Clear saved lessons & progress
Choose Keep my progress
Open Saved to confirm the bookmark is still present
Return to Privacy & sources and choose Clear saved lessons & progress again
Choose Yes, clear it
Open Saved and Home to check state
expected: The first cancellation retains saved lessons; final confirmation clears bookmarks and learning progress, returning the progress indicator to 0%.
